prompt:
LOCAL HUMAN FACE DESIGN SIMPLIFICATION of this exact UNARMED blue ghost-armored guard.
The user says the HUMAN FACE is still too detailed and not graphically summarized. Make a decisive, visibly simpler project-icon face. Edit the human head/face/beard only; not the guardian face on his shoulder.

HUMAN FACE — BIG SHAPES, MINIMAL MARKS:
Keep same adult male identity, stern protective personality, head size and orientation.
Rebuild facial silhouette as a BROAD BLOCKY forehead, one simple strong cheek plane and a SQUARED lower jaw, not many pointed little contours.
Eyebrows = TWO solid short thick dark wedge shapes, no individual hairs or long tapered decorative ends.
Eyes = TWO compact simple white/cream eye shapes beneath the brows, each with ONE flat dark-amber or dark pupil, no iris rings, multicolored gradients, multiple highlights, lashes, lower-lid wrinkles or deep eye-socket rendering. Expression should come from brow angle and eye shape.
Nose = ONE clean broad wedge with a single short underside shadow; delete multiple bridge contour lines, nostril rendering, tiny highlights and skin creases.
Mouth = ONE short firm line with quiet lip shape, mostly integrated with moustache; remove realistic lips, frown creases, nasolabial folds and chin creases.
Moustache = ONE broad simple dark shape with two controlled ends. Beard = ONE large angular dark chin mass with at most TWO or THREE silhouette points, replacing the many spiky locks. Preserve the ivory beard accent as ONE broad clean streak, not several little white teeth/strands.
Hair around face = THREE or FOUR broad coherent dark locks, no small strands. Preserve topknot, general hairstyle and head position.
Skin uses ONLY TWO main flat matte colors: warm base and ONE connected broad side-shadow plane. An optional tiny lighter forehead/cheek plane is allowed but no scattered facets. All small shadow triangles, wrinkles, pores and subtle gradient modeling removed.

Aim for a bold hand-drawn game-icon face that remains immediately readable at a small size, with approximately half or fewer internal lines than the input. Strong silhouette and clear eyes/brows carry the expression, not fine render detail. Do not make him a child, a silly caricature, featureless mask or a literal stone/crystal face.
Preserve everything else: huge blue guardian-mask shoulder, pale collar/cyan ghost curls, simple blue/navy/silver armor, two empty hands, body proportions, stance, boots and background. No weapons, new props, new color accents, changes to armor or pose.
Output the same complete full-body square image with the face now clearly more GRAPHIC, SIMPLE and BOLD. No labels, frame or collage.
purpose: Simplify the human face into bold brows/eyes, one nose plane, grouped moustache/beard and two skin values; preserve the unarmed armor design.
visual_review: Human face now uses bold brow wedges, simplified eyes/nose and a grouped dark beard with one ivory streak; armor and empty hands retained.
